choices.content: Take only the value with the highest probability
Divide the maximum value by the number of values
Use the probabilities as weights and add the weighted values

question.prompt: How are the values of a discrete random variable averaged to obtain its mean?

solutions.explanation: The mean is a probability-weighted average: multiply each possible value by its probability, then add the products. Values with higher probabilities have a greater influence on the mean. Thus the answer is D.
solutions.title: Meaning of probability weights
